newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit's Conrowa eyes China.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit's Conrowa eyes China.

text.p: Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd's Leading Spirit Conrowa Electric Co Ltd (LSC) is expected to use funds raised by its share issue to expand production and strengthen its China distribution network, analysts said.

"The proceeds are expected to be used to fund construction of a factory building and to buy equipment and facilities for the plant, and to build a warehouse in China," said an analyst after attended a company presentation on Wednesday.
"Proceeds will also be used to established special shops and outlets in China, with the balance for working capital," he said.
Analysts said LSC currently has a distribution network of more than 330 outlets in China
LSC, a spinoff of Leading Spirit, is engaged in the design, manufacture, assembly and sale of electrical home appliances such as television sets, washing machines and air-conditioners.
It also trades parts and components for the manufacture of home appliances. Analysts said most of the company's products are for the China market.
